title: Kentucky EEO certification renewal process — RTEC historical workflow
authority: Commonwealth of Kentucky Finance and Administration Cabinet, Office of Equal Employment Opportunity/Contract Compliance
recurring_controls: The form warns that all questions must be completed and that incomplete/substitute forms will not be processed.
Employment data must not be more than 90 days old.
The form asks whether RTEC has a current Affirmative Action Plan and records the plan year.
The form asks about employment-practice fines/penalties and contract ineligibility within the prior five years.
The certifying official attests that the form/attachments are true and accurate and agrees to comply with Kentucky EEO Act KRS 45.550-KRS 45.640 and Cabinet rules/regulations.

observed_changes: The 2010 form lists Barren County in the primary hiring area; the 2016 and 2023 forms do not.
The stated workforce-data collection method changes from I-9 in 2010 to payroll plus voluntary AAP data sheets and the employee database by 2016 and remains that way in the 2023 form.
The EEO contact title expands to EEO Manager/HR Manager by the 2023 form.
Company-wide and Kentucky workforce counts are identical in the sampled forms because the forms record one Kentucky location; this is source evidence, not a general rule.
process_flow: Confirm the current Kentucky certification renewal form and deadline.
Confirm company identity/location and current hiring-area information.
Confirm the current AAP plan year and disclose any source-requested legal/contract eligibility issues.
Collect workforce data within the form's 90-day freshness window using the approved current data source.
Enter company-wide and Kentucky totals for total, ethnic-minority and female employees.
Have an authorized official certify and sign the submission.
Retain the submission and resulting approval/expiration notice in the certification version history.
privacy_and_currentness: The annual renewal form contains aggregate workforce totals; person-level source data used to calculate those totals must remain restricted.
The 2010 I-9 collection method is historical evidence only and must not be automatically revived as a current demographic-data collection method.
The newest available approval letter establishes certification only through 2026-09-30; a later renewal/approval has not been established.
